gloss: beloved wife; wife one married for love

definitions.gloss: beloved wife; wife one married for love
definitions.explanation: A wife whom one married out of romantic love rather than through an arranged marriage. Carries a warm, affectionate nuance. Somewhat old-fashioned in tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{恋女房|こいにょうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{恋女房|こいにょうぼう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: He started a small shop together with his beloved wife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}し{切|き}って→押し切る：06793_oshikiru⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{恋女房|こいにょうぼう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧30⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's been 30 years since I married my beloved wife against everyone's objections.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧ (romantic love) and ⟦{女房|にょうぼう}→女房：12212_nyoubou⟧ (wife, somewhat old-fashioned). The word implies that the marriage was a love match ({恋愛結婚|れんあいけっこん}) as opposed to an arranged marriage (⟦{見合|みあ}い→見合い：14159_miai⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧). Has a warm, slightly nostalgic tone and is used more in narrative or literary contexts than everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恋女房|こいにょうぼう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: together with one's beloved wife
- {恋女房|こいにょうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めとる: to take a beloved wife

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {愛妻|あいさい}: beloved wife — a more modern and common term
- ⟦{女房|にょうぼう}→女房：12212_nyoubou⟧: wife — the base word, somewhat old-fashioned/casual
- ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧: wife — the standard neutral term
- ⟦{奥|おく}さん→奥さん：02853_okusan⟧: wife (of someone else) — polite everyday term
